case_title: Manik & Ors. v. The State of Maharashtra
aggravating_circumstances: Custodial torture, concocted case, false evidence, disappearance of body
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.304-II r/w s.34, s.330, s.348, s.387 r/w s.34, and other charges
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction and sentences except under s.201 r/w s.34
offence_finally_established: Custodial torture under s.330, s.348, s.387 r/w s.34
neutral_facts: The accused, who were members of the police force, were alleged to have subjected the victim to custodial torture and tampered with evidence. The victim was taken into police custody for interrogation in connection with a house-breaking incident. During interrogation, the victim was subjected to third-degree methods, resulting in his death. An unidentified body, which was burnt and buried, was found in a forest area. The prosecution alleged that the accused concocted a case to escape prosecution for the custodial death by making a person named Dipak Lokhande impersonate the victim and stage an escape. The trial court found that the prosecution succeeded in establishing the charge under s.304-II r/w s.34 against some accused, while others were found guilty under other charges. The high court confirmed the conviction and sentences except for certain charges.
